proof_preservation: All accepted mathematical text, equations, attribution, hypotheses, caveats, and citations are retained byte-for-byte.
inspection_limits: Source-statement and selected-page inspection only; no fresh web retrieval or full proof audit of the cited articles during preparation.
scope: Known negative unrestricted nonreversible L2 extension; no whole-Problem-E closure, novelty, or contradiction of reversible or nonlocal-gradient theorems.
